The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] appointed a '''Imperial Governor''' for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was determined to increase the profit-producing capacity of the Tynnans and pressured the legislature into capitulating to his goals. Despite their accommodation, the governor was not satisfied.
